architecture_summary: Modular React app. Core: design system components (src/components/), pages (src/pages/), router (React Router v6). State: local component state. Styling: CSS Modules. No global state manager (YAGNI).

tickets.title: Design system foundation - button, badge, card components
tickets.description: Convert Stitch button, badge, card HTML/CSS to reusable React components. Extract shared props (size, variant, disabled). Use CSS Modules for styling. Support all variants shown in screens.
acceptance_criteria: All variants (primary, secondary, outline, etc.) work

tickets.title: Input, toast, loader, skeleton components
tickets.description: Build input (text, select, checkbox), toast notification, loader, skeleton components. Inputs: validation states (error, success). Toast: auto-dismiss, manual dismiss. Loader: spinner + progress bar variants. Skeleton: shimmer effect.

tickets.title: Tab and table components
tickets.description: Build tab component (horizontal, vertical layouts) and table component (sortable headers, pagination). Tab: controlled/uncontrolled modes. Table: row selection, hover effects.
acceptance_criteria: Tab switching works without page reload

tickets.title: Playful bento showcase page
tickets.description: Convert bento showcase screen to React page. Use design system components. Responsive grid layout. Hover animations as shown in design.

tickets.title: Feature highlights page
tickets.description: Build feature highlights page. Use card components. Scroll animations for feature cards. Responsive layout.

tickets.title: 404 error pages (3 variants)
tickets.description: Build 3 distinct 404 error pages. Randomly select variant on 404 route. Use design system components where applicable. Include 'Back to Home' button.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Navigation bar with logo, menu items. React Router v6 setup. Route definitions for all pages. 404 fallback route. Layout component for consistent header/footer.
acceptance_criteria: Navigation bar present on all pages
